title: Crochet Shell Stitch Granny Square (Style II)
author: Loopara
notes: Round 1 already starts with a magic ring; a 'Make a magic ring.' start line was added. The page does not say where the corner groups and v-stitches go; the DSL puts them in the centre dc of each 7-dc shell (the only placement consistent with the shell counts of rounds 4, 6 and 8: 4, 12 and 16 shells), and sc/7-dc into alternate spaces. Round 7's text has a garbled bracket ('twice.] 3 times'); transcribed as v-st, ch 5, v-st, ch 5, then [corner, ch 5, v-st, ch 5, v-st, ch 5] 3 times, corner, ch 5, which gives round 8's 16 shells. 'Weave in all ends to finish' dropped.
